observations.explanation: Table 1 reports gains on both validation and test sets for GPT-4: pass@5 rises from 19% to 44% on validation and from 12% to 29% on test (PDF p. 7).
The paper describes the stages, including reflection, generating and ranking possible solutions, adding AI-generated tests, and iterative repair against public and AI-generated tests (PDF pp. 3–4).

The paper notes differences in prior methods and evaluation, mentions subtleties such as multiple solutions and tolerance, and says prior work did not release reproducible end-to-end code and evaluation scripts (PDF p. 7).

The cited comparison evaluates the full AlphaCodium flow against a single direct prompt, without isolating the contribution of individual stages (PDF pp. 6–7). The claim is appropriately limited to what those results establish.
